summary: Prudential plc furnished a Form 6-K reporting daily open-market repurchases of its 5 pence ordinary shares under buyback programs authorized at the 2025 and 2026 AGMs and executed through JP Morgan Securities plc as intermediary. Between 28 September and 2 October 2026 the company bought 3,858,167 shares on the London Stock Exchange at volume-weighted average prices of roughly 917p to 945p, with the shares to be cancelled; total voting rights fall to 2,477,986,728. Cumulative purchases under the programs total 75,960,241 shares at a 1,058.49p VWAP. Watch execution pace and any acceleration or suspension of the program.
